note: ショップアイテムの画像生成定義。安全フィルタ対策として、特定人物を連想させる固有名詞(ダンス技名・帽子の型名など)はprompt本文から除外してある。値を書き換えるときは promptVersion を上げること。

common.stylePrefix: Icon illustration for a study app. Pure black (#0b0b10) background, gold (#d9b24a to #f0c75e) as the dominant color. Square 1:1, 512x512px. A single subject centered and large with even margins. Glossy metallic finish with a soft golden rim glow. Stylish, slightly stylized illustration, not photorealistic. Readable at small sizes. No text, no logos, no watermarks.
common.negative: no people, no human figures, no faces, no hands, no body parts, no celebrity likeness, no real-world brands, no text, no watermark

items.prompt: A pair of crisp white glossy socks floating in mid-air, white standing out against black, a subtle gold rim light, clean and fresh, suggesting a humble first step.

items.nameJa: スパンコールのグローブ
items.prompt: A costume accessory densely covered in thousands of tiny reflective sequins, shaped like an empty flat mitten laid on a dark surface, glittering gold and white, scattered light particles around it.
A black wide-brimmed hat with a gold ribbon band, tilted slightly, floating in mid-air, a thin gold light tracing the curve of the brim.
A leather belt with a large ornate gold buckle, curving gracefully in mid-air, the buckle gleaming brightly, trophy-like craftsmanship.

items.nameJa: ライトアップジャケット
items.prompt: An empty black stage jacket on an invisible form, with glowing gold light strips running along its seams and collar, the whole garment softly illuminated from within.
Evenly spaced golden sound waves pulsing in a steady regular rhythm, with an abstract golden pendulum shape at the center. Stable, unbroken, metronomic composition.
A trail of glowing gold footprint shapes receding from right to left, each one fainter than the last, with a soft silver moonlight reflection on a dark floor. Only footprints and light trails.
Concentric golden light rings spinning at high speed with motion-blur afterimages, forming a spiral vortex converging toward a bright center point.
A tall golden pillar of light frozen at an impossible diagonal tilt, with small luminous particles floating weightlessly around it, suggesting suspended gravity.

items.nameJa: アンチグラビティ・リーン
items.prompt: A dawn sky gradient from deep black to pale gold. A single beam of light rising diagonally from the horizon, with the soft glow of a just-rising sun. Quiet early-morning atmosphere.
A night street corner with cracked asphalt lit by one golden streetlamp, a simple portable radio at the edge. Humble and quiet. Completely empty of people.
Interior of a small music venue with a low ceiling, a compact empty stage, and a few golden spotlights cutting through haze. Intimate and warm. Empty floor.
Interior of a large octagonal hall, golden light radiating down from a high ceiling onto an empty central stage. Traditional East Asian architectural silhouette. Solemn and grand. Empty seats.

Interior of a massive domed stadium viewed from above, circular tiers surrounding a glowing golden stage at the center. Countless tiny points of light fill the stands, rendered purely as light particles.
Earth seen from space, golden pillars of light rising from continents around the globe, connected by arcing golden lines across the surface. Epic planetary scale.
A slim unbranded gold-and-black beverage can, with bursting light effects rising from its opening, contents glowing from within.
A single stage spotlight fixture casting a golden cone of light downward, forming a circular pool of light on a dark floor. Calm and steady.
A mirror ball spinning wildly, shooting golden and white light rays in every direction, with a flame-like orange-to-gold glow. Explosive screen-filling energy.
A shield symbol wrapped in soft golden light, surrounded by gentle floating healing particles. Protective and calm, not aggressive.
